title: § 28-218.3 Appointment of a safety compliance officer.

blocks.html:
The owner or contractor shall employ, at the owner's or contractor's expense, an SCO approved by the department.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
